allow: PowerShell("--- /jobs \(no auth\):"; curl.exe -sS -o nul -w "STATUS=%{http_code} REDIRECT_URL=%{redirect_url} SIZE=%{size_download}`n" http://localhost:3000/jobs; "--- /jobs with -L \(follow\):"; curl.exe -sS -L -o "$env:TEMP\\smart_jobs.html" -w "FINAL_STATUS=%{http_code} FINAL_URL=%{url_effective} NUM_REDIRECTS=%{num_redirects}`n" http://localhost:3000/jobs; "--- markers after following redirect:"; Select-String -Path "$env:TEMP\\smart_jobs.html" -Pattern '<title>|cl-signIn|cl-component|sign-in|SignIn|Coming soon' -AllMatches | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches.Value } | Select-Object -First 10)

PowerShell("--- /sign-in: 404 occurrences in context:"; Select-String -Path "$env:TEMP\\smart_signin.html" -Pattern '.{40}404.{40}' -AllMatches | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches.Value } | Select-Object -First 3; "--- /sign-in: body content \(after main tag\):"; $sin = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\smart_signin.html" -Raw; $bodyStart = $sin.IndexOf\('<body'\); if\($bodyStart -gt 0\) { $sin.Substring\($bodyStart, [Math]::Min\(1200, $sin.Length - $bodyStart\)\) })

PowerShell("--- /sign-up body shell:"; $sup = Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\smart_signup.html" -Raw; $bodyStart = $sup.IndexOf\('<body'\); if\($bodyStart -gt 0\) { $sup.Substring\($bodyStart, 600\) }; "`n--- /sign-up: SignUp chunk reference:"; Select-String -Path "$env:TEMP\\smart_signup.html" -Pattern '"SignUp"|sign-up/%5B%5B\\.\\.\\.sign-up%5D%5D' -AllMatches | ForEach-Object { $_.Matches.Value } | Select-Object -First 4)
